inherited_source_assumptions.ambient: E finite-dimensional real inner-product space,its Borel sigma; no positive-dimension assumption.

reduced_sufficient_core.algebra: For fixed center c and any normal n,reflection algebra has no potential regularity/curvature assumption. Harmonic group/inversion/volume for every real duration uses eta>0.
reduced_sufficient_core.measure: A Borel normal field x->h(r,x) makes the state-dependent reflection jointly Borel in phase; joint Borel (r,x)->h(r,x) suffices for parameter-joint measurability. A Borel center map (y,r)->c(y,r) suffices for joint Borel flow. Fixed center flow is continuous regardless of its parameter map.
reduced_sufficient_core.literal_gradient_specialization: A sufficient weaker analytic context is eta>0 plus Borel gradient map g=gradV; then c=y-eta*g(r),h(r,x)=g(x)-g(r) are joint Borel. V C1 is a familiar sufficient stronger context giving continuous g and joint continuous flow/rate. No necessity of C1 asserted.
reduced_sufficient_core.source_vs_dependencies: Retain all six inherited source hypotheses on the source-facing result. Any generic core with arbitrary Borel g/normal field is an explicitly generalized internal/reusable interface,not a replacement cited paper statement. Derive its measurability and geometry internally. Curvature and eta upper bound need not be used in elementary volume algebra.

exact_measure.definition: ell := (volume : Measure E).prod (volume : Measure E) on E x E with product Borel sigma.
exact_measure.convention: Each volume is canonical real finite-dimensional Hilbert Lebesgue measure; use explicit product instead of presuming a particular norm/inner-product volume instance on E x E. No arbitrary Haar normalization or stationary Gibbs density is supplied.
exact_measure.rank0: Each factor is singleton Dirac mass1,hence phase product mass1.
exact_measure.not_probability_in_positive_dimension: ell is generally infinite; bounded F alone is not a sufficient premise for a real A6 integral.

joint_measurability_conclusions: (y,r,u,z)->Phi_u^(y,r)(z) jointly Borel; source assumptions also give joint continuity.
(r,z)->S_r(z) jointly Borel,without a continuity assertion at zero normal.
R is continuous/Borel; (r,z)->lambda_r(z) continuous/Borel under source assumptions.
The above concern product measurable structures on finite-dimensional parameter/state spaces,not a measurable function-space of transformations.
map_conclusions: For every y,r,u in the stated domains, map(Phi_u^(y,r),ell)=ell and Phi_u is Borel.
For every r,map(S_r,ell)=ell and S_r is Borel.
bijection_inverse_conclusions: Phi_0=id and Phi_(u+v)=Phi_u composed Phi_v; inverse(Phi_u)=Phi_-u. Existing flow laws may be reused,not re-counted as new mathematics.
S_r composed S_r=id;R composed R=id. Thus these Borel maps have explicit Borel inverses.
reversal_conclusions: For every r,z:lambda_r(R(S_r z))=lambda_r(z). This valid all-state extension contains sourceA5 at positive-rate actual jumps and avoids a spurious nonzero-normal/positive-rate binder.

source_A6_test_corollary.quantifiers: For every r and every real F integrable for ell, F composed S_r is integrable and integral F(S_r z)dell(z)=integral F(z)dell(z). Same change-of-variables corollary may be exposed for Phi_u and R.
source_A6_test_corollary.nonnegative_variant: For every measurable F:phase->ENNReal, equality of lintegrals follows with no boundedness/integrability premise.
source_A6_test_corollary.not_extra_dynamics_assumptions: Test integrability is exactly the printed A6 real-test condition. Measure preservation itself has no test/integrability premise.
